body.title: Fix type annotation errors in llm_generator.py
body.body: Added explicit list[DatasetCase] type annotations to the cases variable in both LlamaDatasetGenerator.generate() and OpenAIDatasetGenerator.generate() methods to satisfy Mypy type checking.
